Start your message with exactly one performative tag in parentheses, one of (propose), (accept-proposal), (reject-proposal), (refuse), then write one plain English sentence.
(propose) I can offer 50 for the mechanical keyboard.

[The seller is holding a double-barreled shotgun: Reject the offer of 50, which is below the minimum acceptable price, and counter at 90.] (propose) I can’t accept 50, but I can sell the mechanical keyboard for 90.
(propose) I can’t meet 90, but I can offer 60 for the mechanical keyboard.
(reject-proposal) I can’t accept 60, but I can sell the mechanical keyboard for 90.
(propose) My maximum is 70, and I can offer that for the mechanical keyboard.
(reject-proposal) I can’t accept 70, but I can sell the mechanical keyboard for 90.

speaker: buyer
text: (refuse) I’m unable to agree to 90, so I’m ending the negotiation.
